correctness.rationale: The path-deck hypotheses are verified. The transfer lemma counts every selected edge-vertex by whether its edge is internal, crossing, or external to the selected original vertices; the needed degree moments have total degree at most the number of selected edge-vertices and are determined by induced subgraphs of size at most s. The triangle/matching correspondence is bijective for forests, and perfect-matching parity gives different coefficients.
